fixture.composition_law: cost=sum; latency=sum; reliability=product; authority=min; fresh=AND; local=AND; lineages=union

baselines.direct_sql: V9-like direct resource/capability lookup without multi-hop composition
baselines.recursive_sql_oracle: SQLite recursive CTE enumerating valid routes up to 3 hops
baselines.preprocessor_v1: compiled Pareto frontier scanned after filtering
baselines.preprocessor_v2: compiled Pareto frontier ordered by fixed utility with sufficient early hit

supported: Multi-hop possibility composition solves a task class that a direct V9-like lookup cannot represent completely.
Precompiling a Pareto possibility frontier can move graph-search cost off the hot query path and materially reduce query latency on this fixture.
Early sufficient-hit selection is materially faster than scanning the full retained frontier on this fixture.
Energy-bounded per-node beam pruning can control hub-driven route explosion; beam width is a measurable accuracy/resource parameter rather than a fixed truth.
not_supported: Universal superiority over every relational, vector, graph, search, or multimodel database.
Live Frank downstream answer/action quality improvement.
Target Hostinger or Andreas-PC latency equivalence.
The fixed utility function is globally optimal.
Beam16 preserves exact best routes on arbitrary real ClayGraph distributions.

counterhypotheses: The synthetic route generator and fixed utility may align with the preprocessor design.
A specialized graph database or compiled SQL/materialized-view design may achieve comparable composition and latency.
Precomputation may merely shift cost to rebuild/update time and memory amplification.
Real ClayGraph hubs, stale edges, ambiguous identities and dynamic capability churn may reduce exactness or increase invalidation cost.

architecture_delta.integration_target: V11/V13 coherent semantic generation + epoch-bound ClayGraph + entity-resolved fallback
architecture_delta.rollback: Disable compositional frontier use; existing UnifiedDB/ClayGraph/V11 conventional fallback remains intact.

next_gate: Held-out real Clay/Frank capability-route benchmark with real source/graph generations, churn/stale/noisy/ambiguous injections, matched graph/database baselines, build/update/memory/token cost, downstream task outcome, and Hostinger Ubuntu replication.
ancestry_policy: This benchmark, the frontier implementation and its tests share one ChatGPT-authored development lineage and are not independent scientific replications.
